# Climate stress result (`climate-stress` v1)

Expected credit loss on a desk's portfolio under a climate scenario, by sector and horizon.

**Group:** Climate · **Mnemonic:** `CST` · **Identifiers:** `CST-…` in `resultId`

Open one with `CST <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: climate-stress
version: 1
description: "Expected credit loss on a desk's portfolio under a climate scenario, by sector and horizon."
match: { kind: climate-stress, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Climate · Climate stress result, id: $.resultId }
strip:
  - { label: Scenario, bind: $.scenarioName }
  - { label: Desk, bind: $.deskName }
  - { label: Loss (2030), bind: $.loss2030, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Loss (2050), bind: $.loss2050, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Share of capital, bind: $.capitalShare, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: bySector
    kind: hbar
    title: Loss by sector (2030)
    key: F2
    rows: $.bySector
    label: sector
    value: loss
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - id: horizon
    kind: line
    title: Loss by horizon
    area: right
    rows: $.byHorizon
    x: year
    y: loss
    fmt: compact
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.scenario, 'climate-scenario')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
